components.title: Mobile application head
components.note: An open application sits over its member. On a phone it is a sheet docked under the member's head: the grabber, then the application name, and a drag down or a tap on the grabber returns to Apps. Wider than a phone it is an inner page with a chevron back to Apps. No tab bar and no reload.

components.title: Mobile file head
components.note: An open file sits over Files. On a phone it is a sheet docked under the member's head: the grabber, then the file name, and a drag down or a tap on the grabber returns to Files once any edit is saved or let go. Wider than a phone it is an inner page with a chevron back to Files. No tabs; the page under it carries the path, status, and Save.

components.title: Sheet dock
components.note: Mobile only. A mark with no height under a head. On a phone a sheet opened in the page below - the Git change list, an open application or file - docks right here, so the head above it stays in view. A client fills it with whatever measures where the head ends.

components.title: Mobile agent head
components.note: On a phone a team member opens as a sheet over the team that covers the whole screen: its head is the sheet's grabber, then the workspace name above its branch and Reload as accent text, and dragging the head down or tapping the grabber returns to the team. Wider than a phone nothing overlaps: the member is a page, and a back chevron replaces the grabber. No boxed control.

components.title: Task row
components.note: One task on the board. The first row of a group carries that group's label. A review row names its reviewer and revision and has no button: reviewers take reviews themselves. Dequeue, stop, and queue are the same button; the client names which action this row runs and the tone it takes: danger to take work away, primary to give it. One assignee, when there is one, is the round initials on the row.

components.title: Workspace row
components.note: Idle rows are transparent and hover with the neutral state layer. The selected checkout takes an accent tint plus a 2px accent rule on its leading edge, never a saturated fill. Start, identity, and delete are the same controls on Desktop and Mobile. A running workspace shows stop, not play. The LED is the agent state: working, waiting, error, or idle. The branch line is omitted when none is assigned.

components.title: Mobile change sheet
components.note: Mobile only. The change list rests in a sheet at the bottom of the Git page, under the commit box. It opens at a quarter of the page, showing the first rows; their checkboxes work without opening it. Drag up or tap the grabber for the whole list, drag down to bring it back. There is no half detent, no scrim and no close: the list is always there. Wider than a phone there is no sheet; the change list pane scrolls under the commit box. The rows sit on the sheet with no pane of their own.

components.title: Screen
components.note: The window is a column of catalog chrome plus a body. Capture size is a persist concern, not a second theme.

components.note: Desktop body is the rail beside the main column. Mobile does not use this grid.

components.title: Screen tab strip
components.note: Host for au-app-tab. The strip is structure; selection stays on the tab.

components.title: Screen subtab strip
components.note: Host for au-subtab. Secondary selection stays neutral.

components.title: Screen toolbar
components.note: Host for the address bar under application subtabs. Empty when the scene has no browser chrome.

components.title: Screen pane slot
components.note: Working region. Pair with au-pane or a catalog surface; do not force a second screenshot shell.

components.title: Window controls
components.note: Close hover is danger red. Every other chrome hover uses the neutral state layer, never the accent.
